mapper.select: select ifnull((select sum(total_amount) from personal_payment),0) as totalRevenue
select floor(ifnull((select sum(total_amount) from personal_payment), 0) * 0.08) as totalProfitPersonal
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from personal_payment where year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) * 0.08) as month_revenue from personal_payment where year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())

select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from personal_payment where approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month

select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from personal_payment where approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month
select count(*) as period_cnt from personal_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from personal_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from personal_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_payment ( order_id, payment_key, order_name, payment_status, payment_method, total_amount, balance, currency, card_company, card_number, installment_months, easy_payment_provider, receipt_url, requested_at, approved_at, raw_response ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderName}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{balance}, #{currency}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardNumber}, #{installmentMonths}, #{easyPaymentProvider}, #{receiptUrl}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{rawResponse} )
mapper.select: select m.* from personal_payment pp join personal_match_participant p on p.payment_id = pp.payment_id join personal_match m on m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id where pp.payment_key = #{paymentKey}
